title: Booking terms — draft
description: Booking terms. Draft information awaiting final owner-approved business terms.

copy.original: Draft business policy · final terms require owner confirmation.
copy.value: Draft business policy · final terms require owner confirmation.

copy.original: Browsing a sample itinerary or preparing an enquiry does not reserve accommodation, transport, tickets, or any other service. The website does not accept payment.
copy.value: Browsing a sample itinerary or preparing an enquiry does not reserve accommodation, transport, tickets, or any other service. The website does not accept payment.

copy.original: Before booking, obtain the legal business name, invoice details, exact dates, guest names, accommodation and room categories, transport arrangements, meal plan, itemised inclusions and exclusions, total price, applicable taxes, and service availability.
copy.value: Before booking, obtain the legal business name, invoice details, exact dates, guest names, accommodation and room categories, transport arrangements, meal plan, itemised inclusions and exclusions, total price, applicable taxes, and service availability.

copy.original: Ask about identification, permits, insurance, accessibility needs, altitude suitability, and restrictions relevant to your chosen route. Service-specific conditions must be disclosed in your final proposal.
copy.value: Ask about identification, permits, insurance, accessibility needs, altitude suitability, and restrictions relevant to your chosen route. Service-specific conditions must be disclosed in your final proposal.
